notes: Company snapshot: Emberlane builds in-app guided onboarding copilots for mid-market B2B SaaS — product named 'GuideFlow'.
Primary ask: reliable streaming chat + tool calling for step-by-step interactive flows inside product; strict token cost caps per user cohort.
Latency SLO: target p95 <= 250ms for first-streamed token in US regions, happy path; p50 target <= 120ms. Team cares about tail latency consistency.
Cost constraints: goal to cap token spend per active user to ~12k-18k tokens/mo (configurable tiers). Need quota enforcement and per-route token accounting in console.
Model preferences: prefer open/quantized variants if quality equal; want fallback model tiering (smaller model) when Dedicated capacity under pressure.
Security: SSO/SCIM, KMS integration (customer-managed), audit logs for all admin actions, ability to pin EU residency for EU customers' convo data.
Tooling: heavy use of function calling to internal search and account APIs; need deterministic accounting when functions invoked (cost attribution to route).
Quote from Head of Product (02-14 demo): 'We need the onboarding to feel instantaneous. If the chat stalls once, conversion drops.'
AE notes: interested in Hosted API POC first — quick time to value — but roadmap to Dedicated within 6-9 months for predictable throughput and lower unit cost.
POC scope agreed: 4 weeks in staging, replicate 20 RPS conversational sessions (peak 40 RPS), end-to-end from client streaming -> function call -> final stream.
Perf notes from demo: initial token stream latency measured ~180ms in us-west during demo; 95th went up to ~420ms on long-turn scenarios — need engineered fixes/cfg validation.
Engineering asks: support for continuous batching knob, KV cache for convo state, and an ETA on quantized 8-bit kernels for their target model family.
Commercial: want an indicative pricing slide comparing pay-as-you-go Hosted vs 12/24-month Dedicated commit; ask for example committed ARR that hits their cost target.
Legal & compliance: privacy team will send a redline to the DPA; request for minimum data retention window (90 days) and ability to purge transcripts.
Internal owner comment: prioritize creating a route template for onboarding flows (streaming + tools) with token caps and per-route latency SLO reporting in Console.
Next milestone: perf sweep (03-15) + initial cost projection (03-18) + security call with Legal (03-22).

use_case_summary: In-app onboarding copilot (GuideFlow) — guided flows, multi-turn chat with UI hints and async tool calls to search/account APIs.
Requirements: streaming responses for immediate first-token, function/tool calling support, per-session token caps, deterministic billing per-route.
Scale target: mid-market customer base; expected concurrent active users 300-800 after 12 months; planning for burst to 2k concurrent for promotions.
SLOs: p50 <= 120ms, p95 <= 250ms for initial streamed token; overall completion latency budget per step <= 1.2s including function call latency.
Operational: need per-route dashboards, token spend alerts, automatic model fallback policy and cache suggestions to reduce unit cost.
